senses.definition: n.pr.m. (so Baer Ginsb; van d. H. שַׁר׳), chief soothsayer (רַב־מָ֑ג) in train of Nebuchad. Je 39:3a (del. Gie, plausibly) v 3b, 13 (cf. SchrCOT ad loc.).
